title: NZ in December with Kids — What to Expect (Weather, Crowds, Costs)
meta_desc: Plan your NZ family holiday in December with our expert guide to weather, crowds, and costs during peak season.
intro: December is the most popular time to travel in NZ, with the Christmas school holidays bringing large crowds to popular destinations. If you're planning a family holiday during this time, be prepared for higher prices and busy attractions. With some planning, you can still have a fantastic holiday without breaking the bank.

sections.heading: Weather in December
sections.body: December is summer in NZ, with warm weather and long days. The average high temperature in Auckland is 23°C, while in Queenstown it's 22°C. The UV index is high, so don't forget to pack sunscreen and hats for your family.

sections.heading: Popular Beach Destinations
list: Bay of Islands (3.5 hour drive from Auckland, approx. $100-$150 in fuel costs)
Coromandel Peninsula (2 hour drive from Auckland, approx. $50-$70 in fuel costs)
Mount Maunganui (2.5 hour drive from Auckland, approx. $80-$120 in fuel costs)

sections.heading: Costs and Budgeting
sections.body: Accommodation prices skyrocket during peak season, with a family room in a motel costing around $250-$350 per night. Eating out can also be expensive, with a meal for a family of four costing around $80-$120 at a mid-range restaurant.

sections.heading: Book Early to Avoid Disappointment
sections.body: Many popular attractions and activities, such as the Skyline Gondola in Queenstown ($40-$60 per person) and the Auckland Zoo ($25-$35 per person), can be booked online in advance. This can help you avoid long wait times and ensure that you don't miss out on your preferred activities.
